omission.chore: Identify and block root signing authorities that a system does not need, using a user-reviewed list.
omission.evidenceQuote: After the recent eMudhra CA incident, I wondered why my system trusts over 150 root signing authorities, most of which I don't need? I decided to scratch my own itch and make a tool to block the long
omission.reason: This is a specific tool request around managing unnecessary trusted root authorities. A bounded prototype could compare a synthetic trust list and require human review without changing a live system; the exclusion's lack of an external request does not justify skipping assessment.
